description: Additional protected and unsafe remote path synchronization cases for hidden directories and untracked modifications.

cases.description: A remote file in an arbitrary hidden directory is written under the conflict area and not directly into the workspace.
A remote modification to a locally added untracked file is preserved as a conflict copy while local content remains unchanged.
